alkylation reagent: Protein alkylation was performed with 0.05 M iodoacetamide in an urea buffer for 20 min at RT.
alkylation concentration: Protein alkylation was performed with 0.05 M iodoacetamide in an urea buffer for 20 min at RT.
cleavage agent: Finally, trypsinization of proteins (trypsin ratio 1:100, Sigma-Aldrich, Darmstadt, Germany), centrifugation at 16,000 g for 10 min, and lyophilization were performed.
collision energy: Normalized collision energy was set to 33 and the precursor ions were excluded for final activation (45 s, 5 ppm mass tolerance).
fragmentation method: were subjected in a higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) fragmentation.
instrument: coupled with the high resolution nano-ESI Orbitrap-Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
ionization type: coupled with the high resolution nano-ESI Orbitrap-Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: LC/MS was performed in hUAs before and after the application of the decellularization method.
reduction reagent: A sample reduction with 10 mM DTE for 20 min at room temperature (RT), was performed.
reduction concentration: A sample reduction with 10 mM DTE for 20 min at room temperature (RT), was performed.
